title: The Beggar's Opera
author: John Gay
description: "The Beggar's Opera" by John Gay is a ballad opera written in 1728 with music arranged by Johann Christoph Pepusch.
longDescription: This groundbreaking work satirizes Italian opera, corrupt politics, and social injustice by featuring thieves, whores, and ordinary criminals instead of grand operatic heroes.

authorInfo.bio: John Gay (1685–1732) wrote The Beggar's Opera. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
